description: Report on learning semantics in the v5.11-dev build.

learning_signal.current: predicted_delta used as learning reward via record_outcome(..., predicted_delta)
learning_signal.problem: Self-confirming learning. Policy learns from its own prediction, not from realized outcome.
learning_signal.required: realized_delta = U_after - U_before. Capture u_before during observation, u_after after commit.

calibration.current: calibrator.update(predicted_delta, u_now) — compares delta prediction against absolute utility
calibration.problem: Dimensionally incorrect. Comparing a change (delta) against a level (absolute utility).

credit_assignment.problem: Hierarchical credit fields (diagnostic, candidate, planner, action, governance, prediction) are not populated.
credit_assignment.required: Populate all credit fields from actual subsystem outcomes. Make credit attribution observable and testable.

learning_transition.predicted_outcome: set to predicted_delta (correct field, wrong value for reward)
learning_transition.realized_outcome: set to u_now (absolute utility, not delta)
